badgeTip.message:
Tokens saved this session by TokenLens compressor.
Measured from actual char reduction (chars÷4 heuristic).
Updated only after each response completes.
Input: contractions, fillers, markdown history stripping.
badgeTip.description: Tooltip on the savings badge in Claude header

quota5hTip.message:
Your rolling 5-hour usage quota.

Resets 5 hours after your first message
in the current window. Shared across all
conversations on this account.

Token-weighted: long messages and detailed
responses consume more quota than short ones.
Magic compression reduces how fast this fills.

wmTip.message:
Without Magic: estimated 5h quota you’d have used without compression.

  ██ Orange = actual usage now
  ██ Purple = where you’d be without Magic

What gets compressed:
· Input: contractions, fillers, whitespace
· History: markdown from past assistant turns
· Output: ~15–20% fewer tokens

Conservative estimate — real savings often higher.
wmTip.description: Tooltip on the without-magic comparison bar

wmHeaderText.description: Label in the without-magic section header

quota7dTip.message:
Your rolling 7-day usage quota.

Resets 7 days after your first message
in the current window. Shared across all
conversations on this account.

Fills more slowly than the 5h quota — this
is the longer-term ceiling on your usage.

ctxPillLabel.description: Label on the context window pill

ctxPillTip.message:
Estimated context window usage.

Token counting (heuristic):
· Code blocks: chars ÷ 3
· URLs & numbers: chars ÷ 2
· Regular text: words × 1.3

As this approaches 100%, Claude may start
losing memory of earlier messages.
Model limit shown as denominator.
ctxPillTip.description: Tooltip on the context window pill

spdPillTip.message:
Output speed of the last response.
Measured in tokens per second (t/s).

Typical range: 30–80 t/s.
Lower during peak hours or on longer outputs.

turnsPillTip.message:
Number of complete assistant responses

turnsPillTip.description: Tooltip on the turn count pill

costPillTip.message:
Estimated token cost at Claude API rates.

this is a reference figure, not what
you’re actually charged.

latPillTip.message:
Average time-to-first-token (TTFT)
across all responses this session.

Measures how long the server takes to start
responding — not total generation time.
Higher during peak hours.

magicPillTip.message:
Net tokens saved this session by Magic.

Counted after each response:
· Input: contractions, fillers, whitespace
· History: markdown stripped from past turns
· Code: comments & JSON whitespace removed

Fewer tokens = slower quota drain.

magicEstSub.message: Send a message to start measuring actual savings

magicDesc.message: Magic compresses your messages before sending — removes filler words, shrinks conversation history, and instructs Claude to skip decorative formatting — so your 5-hour quota drains more slowly.

techWhitespaceTip.message: Curly quotes → straight, em-dashes → --, extra blank lines collapsed, trailing spaces stripped. Saves 0–3 tokens per typical message.

techContractionsTip.message: "will not" → "won't" (2 tokens → 1), "do not" → "don't", etc. BPE tokenizers treat contractions as single tokens. Saves ~0.5–1 token per occurrence.

techFillersTip.message: "in order to" → "to" (−3 tokens), "it is important to note that" → deleted (−6 tokens). Largest single input saving for verbose writing styles.

techNumbersTip.message: "1,000,000" → "1M". Saves ~1–2 tokens per number. Code blocks untouched. Low impact unless you write lots of large numbers.

techCodeCommentsTip.message: Strips // line, /* */ block, and # comments from pasted code fences before sending. Real, measurable. Check the badge % — it reflects actual chars removed.

techJsonMinifyTip.message: Minifies ```json blocks — removes all whitespace. Only applies to valid JSON. Typically saves 20–40% of the JSON token cost.

techNoMarkdownOutputTip.message: Injects ~8 tokens of directive ("Plain text only…"). In exchange, Claude skips markdown decorators (##, **, -, etc.) — net output savings of 5–15% on typical prose. Not tracked in badge (output side only).
techNoMarkdownOutputTip.description: Tip for plain text output directive

techNoPreambleTip.message: Adds ~6 tokens of directive. Removes openers like "Great question!" and closers like "Let me know if you need anything else." Net save: ~10–40 tokens per response.

techExpertModeTip.message: Adds ~7 tokens of directive. Claude skips introductory context, definitions, and warnings for technical topics. Net save varies widely (0–30%) depending on query type.

techStripHistoryMarkdownTip.message: Removes ##, **, - etc. from past assistant messages before they re-enter context as input tokens. Fully measurable — reflected in the badge %. You still see formatted output.
techStripHistoryMarkdownTip.description: Tip for markdown stripping from history
